productDetail.reviews.title: Customer Reviews
productDetail.reviews.seed.review1.name: Minh Tran
productDetail.reviews.seed.review1.conte: I live in tees and this one matches the size chart for an oversized cut. Fabric weight feels right—not stiff—and the print still looks sharp after several washes. Collar hasn’t bacon-necked on me yet.
productDetail.reviews.seed.review2.name: Sofia Le
productDetail.reviews.seed.review2.conte: Soft cotton, breathable for all-day wear. Colours and graphics look like the site photos, and the tee arrived neatly folded—no weird creases on the print.
productDetail.reviews.seed.review3.name: Khanh Nguyen
productDetail.reviews.seed.review3.conte: Solid fabric and stitching for an everyday tee. I’m 165cm in L and it runs a bit long, but that’s the streetwear silhouette I wanted. Peak-hour shipping was a touch slow—product still gets a thumbs up.
